technique_name: Write a 5-sentence summary of the history of the Internet
description: The history of the internet began with the advent of the ARPANET project in the late 1960s, which connected computers over telephone lines. The World Wide Web was developed in 1991 and the browser revolutionized how people could access and share information. During the 1990s, the internet expanded rapidly, allowing people to communicate and exchange data over long distances.
